format: pdf

### Question 1

Which district had the closest race?

### Answer 1

```{r}

district_totals <- votes_clean |>
    group_by(district) |>
    summarize(
        dem _ sum(dem_votes, na.rm = TRUE),
        rep = sum(rep_votes, na.rm = TRUE),
        total = dem + rep,
        margin_pct = abs(dem - rep) / total * 100
    ) |>
    arrange(margin_pct)

head(district_totals, 1)

```


### Question 2

What's the distribution of precint sizes?

### Answer 2

```{r}

precinct_sizes <- votes_clean |>
    mutate(size = dem_votes + rep_votes)

ggplot(precinct_sizes, aes(x = size)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Precinct Sizes",
       x = "Total Votes",
       y = "Number of Precincts") +
  theme_minimal()

summary(precinct_sizes$size)

```


### Question 3

How many districts had blowouts (>20% margin)?

### Answer 3


```{r}
blowouts <- district_totals |>
    filter(margin_pct > 20)

nrow(blowouts)
```
